name: The High Priestess
source:
The High Priestess is the 2nd of the 22 major Arcana in a tarot deck. Her archetype is to guide, a personification of intuition.

[From [url=https://thearcanagame.fandom.com/wiki/The_High_Priestess]The Arcana Wiki[/url]]
